scope: Recovered archived evidence, no new protected-engine execution

fraud.scope: Archived chronological development scores, matched to SHA-verified public labels. Completed 500-transaction groups, not individual transaction detection. Public research implementation, not a new run of the private Coherence Engine. Previously studied dataset, not untouched holdout. Frozen thresholds retained.

ecg.scope: Two distinct historical experiments. Do not pool or substitute their metrics. Not clinical validation or a new execution.

uci-power.scope: Archived developer-reported monthly aggregates, not a rerun. No ground truth or timestamped alert outputs recovered. Alert counts do not establish detection accuracy. Monthly level bands describe archived aggregates, not biological or anomaly thresholds.

optical.scope: Recovered recorded results from the frozen distinct-detector test. Raw channel samples not recovered. These are aggregate comparisons, not a signal replay.
